_about: Catalog rows whose box is known not to fit the model drawn for it, each with its reason (the model inspector, docs/design/model-inspector.md section 4).

Every other catalog row in data/machines/*.ron that draws a model must have a box its fitted model fits (turned by its model_yaw, scaled to its height) within the tolerance in inspect_conventions.json, because the walk, the collision and the flush placement follow the box while the eye follows the model.

Held by gui::model_view::inspect_tests::every_catalog_box_fits_its_fitted_model, which fails on a row that does not fit and is not listed here, and on a listed row that fits now or is gone, so this list only shrinks. node scripts/inspect-model.js --catalog prints the same check.
A row whose model is in a download pack (data/models/packs.ron) that is not installed is not an exception: the check names its pack and judges it wherever the pack is installed.
Each entry: { "file": the machine file, "id": the catalog row, "reason": why its box cannot match its model yet, and what would fix it }.
